data.development_use: one-shot acceptance audit after the train-only model is immutably frozen
loader_checks: regular non-symlink artifact and report files
weights_only artifact load and public-route contract validation
raw artifact SHA256 equals complete report receipt
complete seed by complementary replicate matrix in registered order
replicate assignment vectors are exact Boolean complements
artifact candidate counts and factual summaries equal the report
sealed source/runtime/checkpoint/git receipts agree across every run
all candidate rows retained with no post-trigger filter
data.pilot_use: collector validation only; excluded from fitting, normalization, selection, and acceptance

development.blind_rule: blind collection remains closed unless the immutable development audit passes every acceptance condition
development.doubly_robust_nuisance: frozen five-member ensemble probability mean for each event and arm, clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]

inference.bound: population mean plus_or_minus one population standard deviation across five members, clipped to [0,1]
inference.decision: continue iff continue_success_LCB - route_success_UCB >= 0.05 AND continue_drop_UCB <= route_drop_LCB AND continue_unsafe_UCB <= route_unsafe_LCB; otherwise route
inference.failure_default: fixed route for non-finite values, invalid model, or underpowered data

normalization.fit_rows: all and only train-cohort factual candidate rows

optimization.initialization: PyTorch Linear default initialization after torch.manual_seed(member_seed)
optimization.loss: unweighted BCEWithLogits over exactly the assigned arm's three factual heads; the other three masks are zero
optimization.runtime: CPU float32 model, one intra-op thread, one inter-op thread, torch deterministic algorithms enabled
optimization.shuffle: one CPU torch.Generator seeded by member_seed; one randperm over all rows at each epoch

bootstrap.ci: sort 20000 estimates ascending and use fixed one-based order-statistic ranks 500 and 19500
bootstrap.resampling_unit: within each development seed, resample its observed seed_x_env_slot clusters with replacement to the same observed-cluster count; every available a/b row stays together and multiplicity is preserved
bootstrap.seed: unsigned big-endian integer from the first 8 bytes of SHA256(trial_manifest_sha256 + NUL + development_cluster_bootstrap_v1)

permutation.seed: unsigned big-endian integer from the first 8 bytes of SHA256(trial_manifest_sha256 + NUL + development_cluster_permutation_v1)
permutation.swap: independently for each development seed and Monte Carlo replicate, choose exactly 256 of 512 env slots as replicate-a route; replicate-b is the exact complement; apply those arm labels to every available row without changing features or outcomes
